author: Yahoo Finance
title: Apple, Twitter and Nike are the Yahoo Finance charts of the day [Video]
text:
Let’s check out the Yahoo Finance charts of the day.
Apple ( AAPL ): Shares are up in early trade, around 2.1%. Billionaire investor Warren Buffett tells CNBC that he added 75 million shares of the tech giant’s stock to his portfolio.
Twitter ( TWTR ): Shares down here, around 2.0%. The social networking service urged its users to change their passwords after a glitch in its internal computer caused some passwords to be readable.
Nike ( NKE ): Shares up, around 0.52%. Last month Nike’s toxic workplace culture was revealed and Wall Street Journal reports that CEO Mark Parker apologized to his employees at an all-staff meeting this week.
For more on today’s big stock movers check out the Final Round, live at 3:55 p.m. ET, right here on Yahoo Finance.
